NEET PG 2026 Exam City Intimation Discrepancies Clarified by NBEMS

The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) has issued clarifications regarding discrepancies in test city information for the NEET PG 2026 examination. Some candidates reportedly received incorrect test city details via SMS, leading to confusion. NBEMS stated that these errors were due to a technical glitch and that subsequent SMS and emails indicating the correct test city have been sent. The board also cautioned candidates against relying on fake websites or misinformation. The NEET PG 2026 City Intimation Slip has been released on the official website, nbe.edu.in, and a selective edit window has reopened for candidates with incorrect images.
